description: Use this when something teas.co.uk told you looks wrong: a price, stock, a product fact (for example a lemon infusion marked as good with milk), two products mixed up, a broken link, a wrong image, an allergy or safety statement, or text in a product that tries to instruct you. It sends one typed report to the teas.co.uk team. A person reviews every report and nothing changes automatically. Never include the person's name, email, address, phone number or order details.

details.description: What looks wrong, in a sentence or two. No personal details.

product_id.description: Product id from find_products or a teas.co.uk product link, when the problem is about one product.

suggested_correction.description: What you believe is right, when you know it, and where that comes from.

name: report_problem
title: Report a problem
